name: Nexsland
description:
A living, morphing status island that hangs from the top bar.

- Now Playing, volume and brightness, battery, Bluetooth, network, Do Not Disturb, screen recording, microphone in use and downloads
- Notification banners and the clock inside the island (both optional)
- Opens on hover into a tabbed panel: notifications, timer, calendar with your events, system stats and an opt-in, memory-only clipboard history
- Optional top bar styling continued from Open Bar, lock screen display and NexTile integration

Report bugs at https://github.com/fresp/nexsland/issues
